description: Purpose: search the public knowledge-card collection - atomic sourced facts compiled from statistics, standards, papers and official announcements. Guidelines: keyword matches title and fact fields; combine type and region to narrow; every card returns its fact summary together with the source it was compiled from. Limits: publicly releasable cards only - cards marked excluded (with an excluded reason) are filtered out at export and never returned; each card is a single fact rather than analysis, and carries no recommendation. Ex: query_cards(keyword='ISCC'), query_cards(type='标准解读', region='欧盟').

keyword.description: 关键词（标题与事实字段全文匹配）

offset.description: 起始偏移，默认 0；返回体 has_more=true 时用 next_cursor 作为下一页 offset

response_format.description: 输出格式：markdown=人类阅读（默认）, json=Agent 处理友好

name: query_cards

text.description: Human-readable result (markdown, or a JSON string when response_format=json).

title: Search Knowledge Cards
